description: Stations de bus à Boucau is a dataset listed in Boucau Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Point d'accès national. Agrégat des différents jeux de données présents sur le point d'accès national présentant les arrêts de bus sur le territoire de Boucau. Coverage: Boucau. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are bus, arrêt, transports, deplacement, Txik Txak. The portal shows 36 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-boucau-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
